pages.title: Risers
pages.text: The riser is the weapon's core — durability and accuracy.$(br)$(li)$(l)Wood$() — 250 dur$(li)$(l)Copper$() — 400 dur, Conductive$(li)$(l)Iron$() — 750 dur, High Precision$(br2)$(l)Conductive$(): during a thunderstorm, a hit calls lightning. $(l)High Precision$(): cuts a bow's random spread to a fifth.

pages.title: Strings
pages.text: The string sets arrow velocity.$(br)$(li)$(l)Spider$() — 1.0x$(li)$(l)Flax$() — 1.3x, Shaky$(li)$(l)High Tension$() — 1.8x (costs 2 durability per shot)$(br2)$(l)Shaky$(): holding a full draw too long jitters your aim.
